title: REQ · Cleanup re-checks the index and fails when node_modules paths stay tracked
summary: untrackAndVerify untracks dependency paths and confirms none remain, de-duplicating unmerged entries
description: Context: untrackNodeModules runs git rm -r --cached but never confirms the result, and unmerged (UU) paths such as node_modules/.vite/vitest/results.json appear up to three times in git ls-files. Desired behavior: a new untrackAndVerify(run) counts unique tracked dependency paths before, runs untrackNodeModules, re-lists, and throws when any remain. Why: to prove all 15,329 files are removed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a runner listing 3 node_modules paths, when untrackAndVerify runs and the second listing is empty, then it returns {before:3, after:0}
Given the second listing still contains node_modules/phaser/package.json, when it runs, then it throws an error containing that path
Given a path listed three times for merge stages, when counting, then it is counted once
